gui.guaniao.bird_guide.title: Bird Guide
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.night_heron: By day it passes for a gray branch by the water. After dusk it starts its quiet shift, beating its wings hard at first, then gliding off as if the dark had somewhere to carry it.
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.sparrow.int: A sparrow is common, but a village feels wrong without it. It hops, pecks, checks on you, and when crumbs hit the ground one bird pretends to wander over before the rest remember they are busy too.
A green noisy cloud over the grass
At sunrise they burst from the trees like a gust of green wind, then spend the day nosing through grass seeds. When music starts, a few simply cannot resist swaying along.
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.spotted_dov: A soft weather call at field edges
Most of the day it walks slowly on the ground, pecking once or twice before lifting its head to coo. When weather begins to turn, its voice grows scarce, as if it heard the rain before you did.
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.pigeon.subt: A familiar face between roofs and squares
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.pigeon.intr: Gray or white, it is perfectly comfortable beside human buildings. It takes its time, walking, pecking, and occasionally fluttering to a new spot before resuming the same routine.

gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.crow.title: Crow
It keeps a cautious distance, watching hands, crumbs, and anything that catches light. Feed it and it calms down for a while; hurt it and nearby crows remember.
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.seagull.int: It patrols beaches, rivers, and docks with the confidence of a bird that has never paid for lunch. Wild gulls scavenge safe scraps and may snatch ordinary food from an inattentive hand; patient feeding can still win one over.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.title: Bird Experience Settings
gui.guaniao.bird_config.reset_notice: Defaults restored; press Save to apply them
gui.guaniao.bird_config.invalid_group: Minimum group size cannot exceed maximum group size
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.scope.de: This Save only affects the current world. Global is used as the default. Multiplayer servers always use the server-global config.
When off, this bird will not spawn naturally, call, or produce natural droppings. Existing birds are preserved.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.april_fo: Makes every bird about 4.7 times larger while preserving species proportions; sparrows become roughly player-sized and birds no longer fear players. Turning it off restores normal behavior immediately.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.natural_: Controls natural and flyby spawning without affecting spawn eggs, commands, or existing birds.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.colonial: Lets sparrows, long-tailed tits, budgerigars, cockatiels, pigeons, and seagulls form large natural flocks only in suitable fixed colony areas.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.natural_: Only generates in suitable new tree-canopy chunks; existing nests are unaffected.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.crow_nes: 1 averages roughly one nest per 14 suitable forest chunks; 0 stops future generation.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.crows_st: Crows carrying shiny items prefer to fly to a claimed, loaded nest and stash them.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.crow_nes: Crows search loaded nests only and never load distant chunks. Default: 96 blocks.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.max_crow: Limits the number of different treasure piles crows can add; existing contents are preserved.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.crows_cl: Lets crows use player-placed nests as caches. When off, they claim only natural nests.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.spawn_mu: 1 keeps the designed rate, 0 stops spawning, and higher values make encounters more likely.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.dropping: 1 keeps the designed rate, 0 stops natural droppings, and higher values shorten the delay.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.sound_mu: 1 keeps the designed volume and 0 mutes the bird, including calls, hurt sounds, and interactions.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.max_bird: Stops additional birds from spawning near players when this limit is reached. Existing birds are preserved.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.max_drop: Limits the number of ground splats that can exist within an eight-block radius.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.min_grou: Minimum number of this bird in one natural spawn group.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.max_grou: Maximum number of this bird in one natural spawn group.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.pet_bird: Sneak-use an owned bird with an empty hand to cycle Free, Follow, Stay, and Roost modes.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.seagull_: Lets wild seagulls steal one safe, ordinary food item from a stack in a player's hand.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.crow_ite: Protects named, NBT-bearing, rare, non-stackable, and container-like items from crow theft and caching.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.max_wild: Hard regional cap for wild birds; tamed, named, and no-AI birds are excluded.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.populati: Width of each population region in chunks. Changing it rebuilds the live counter lazily.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.flock_re: Ticks between shared same-species flock candidate scans.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.habitat_: Ticks that a 64 by 64 habitat evaluation remains reusable.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.seagull_: Per-player delay in ticks after a seagull successfully steals held food.
Maximum number of seagulls that may target one player's held food at once.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.bird_sca: Shared upper budget for deferred bird perception work per server tick.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.max_wild: Soft regional cap for this species; reaching it strongly reduces further natural spawns.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.flock_ra: Maximum distance used by shared exact-species flock queries.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.flock_ma: Maximum live candidates returned to one flock behavior update.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.food_sca: Minimum ticks used between this species' nearby food perception scans.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.threat_s: Minimum ticks used between this species' nearby threat perception scans.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.owner_te: Distance at which a following bird may use a safe recovery teleport when normal following fails.
gui.guaniao.bird_config.setting.ambient_: Multiplier for ambient call intervals and same-flock call throttling; higher is quieter.

gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.long_tailed: A little flock that rests shoulder to shoulder
They are seldom alone. A flock rolls from branch to branch like a string of flying fluff, then squeezes into a neat row at dusk. Feed one gently and the whole flock becomes a little less wary.
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.cockatiel.s: Gentle, sensitive, and hard to overlook
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.cockatiel.i: Small flocks move through dry grass and scrub, their crests and gestures giving away every mood. Once familiar with a player they stay close, sway to music, and return together to a high roost at dusk.
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.macaw.title: Macaw
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.macaw.subti: The loudest color in the canopy
gui.guaniao.bird_guide.entry.macaw.intro: Pairs and small flocks cross the jungle canopy with impossible colors, broad wings, and voices that refuse to be ignored. They avoid lingering on the ground, become high-roosting companions, and occasionally imitate nearby birds.
